def deep_inspect_object(obj, prefix=""):
    print(f"{prefix}Type: {type(obj)}")
    print(f"{prefix}Dir contents:")
    for name in dir(obj):
        if name.startswith('_'):
            continue
        try:
            attr = getattr(obj, name)

            attr_str = str(attr)
            if len(attr_str) > 100:
